name: Revelation
title: Revelation — Unveiling of Jesus Christ
tagline: Behold, He is coming with the clouds.

author.traditional: John (the apostle — traditional and Adam’s lean; “John the prophet” on Patmos).

date.range_display: - **Late date (~95 AD, Domitian):** common in many modern textbooks. - **Early date (pre-70 AD, Nero/Galba era):** strong internal case (temple language, urgency, 666/Neronian calculations in some readings, “things which must shortly take place”). **early date**, Johannine authorship — judgment horizon includes Jerusalem’s fall within the wider cosmic victory of the Lamb. Present both; do not hide the lean.
date.debate: - **Late date (~95 AD, Domitian):** common in many modern textbooks. - **Early date (pre-70 AD, Nero/Galba era):** strong internal case (temple language, urgency, 666/Neronian calculations in some readings, “things which must shortly take place”).
date.usmc_lean: early (pre-70) with traditional Johannine authorship; late-date (~95, Domitian) presented fairly

audience: Seven churches of Asia — and every church under pressure.
purpose: Unveil Jesus Christ; strengthen perseverance; promise victory to conquerors.
christ: Focus entire — slain Lamb, roaring Lion, coming King, husband of the Bride.
spirit: Speaks to the churches; seven Spirits before the throne; “the Spirit and the Bride say, Come.”
jesus_in_this_book: Focus entire — slain Lamb, roaring Lion, coming King, husband of the Bride.
how_to_read: Not a conspiracy timeline first — a unveiling of Jesus for embattled saints. Recapitulation and symbolism matter; so does real judgment and real hope. Anti-dispensational chart religion is not required to take the book seriously.
watchman_charge: Hear what the Spirit says to the churches. Conquer by the blood of the Lamb and the word of your testimony. Worship the throne — not the beast. ---
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
